assertions: Actual ContentInfo and pool-bound XEditAttribute values drive native section partitioning.
Paragraph normalization uses the actual existing SharedStringPool and source uppercase behavior.

stackDivergence.rationale: Task180 implements original Section fields/constructor and EditTextObjectImpl GetAllSections payload over actual ContentInfo/XEditAttribute. Native paragraph/border ordering,unformatted and empty sections,borrowed item references,first-Which duplicate suppression and caller-output swap/early-return behavior remain intact. UInt32 projection has the same unsigned ordering as native size_t for signed32 border producers and Section parameters recover signed32 values;no binary storage is simulated. Redundant zero-border conjunct and impossible missing-paragraph branch are folded from proven construction invariants. ContentInfo NormalizeString uses actual SharedStringPool while retaining its stable SharedString member. Existing shared owners are reused without fake text/pool/document objects. Native pool-dependent EditTextObjectImpl/EditEngineItemPool constructors,render/layout services and connected Calc document/UI/same-model ODS remain pending;no broad parity claim.
